description:
I’m Michael Agyei Yeboah, a Full-Stack Software Engineer & AI Integration Specialist experienced in cloud architectures, web/mobile apps, and computer vision.

We’re building Aniwa ("Eye" in Twi) for Dancing with the SARs. It’s a real-time satellite platform tackling deforestation. Using cloud-penetrating NASA-ISRO (NISAR) & Sentinel-1 SAR data, Aniwa cuts through tropical clouds to deliver high-res canopy loss detection & early alerts. Looking for GIS, UI/UX, and devs to join us!
